reason: Guide quote 1 states new clusters created on or after February 18, 2026 are encrypted by default with an AWS owned key; guide quote 3 states that for sources created before that date where you did not opt in, snapshots, clones and Aurora replicas remain unencrypted (opt-in before the date); What's New quote 4 states existing clusters remain unaffected.
